advice_items.quote: one of the things that I love to teach my son is take a risk
advice_items.summary_en: Take calculated risks when starting out instead of letting fear hold you back.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业起步要敢于承担风险

advice_items.quote: if you believe in yourself and you believe in what you do then the chances are you will be a success
advice_items.summary_en: Believe deeply in yourself and your work to create a high likelihood of success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定相信自己和所做之事

advice_items.quote: I was able to reinvest my profit over and over and over and what that did was that allowed me to get larger and larger
advice_items.summary_en: Continuously reinvest profits back into your business to scale from six to seven figures and beyond.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把利润反复再投资以做大规模

advice_items.quote: do a 1031 exchange and what that does it allows you to push out your taxes because you rolling your profit into your next build
advice_items.summary_en: Use tax-deferral tools like 1031 exchanges to roll profits into larger real estate builds.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用1031置换递延税款滚大项目

advice_items.quote: I'm a great believer in hard work pays off
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a strong work ethic because consistent hard work pays off over time.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚信努力付出终有回报

advice_items.quote: know your goal focus on the goal and don't stop until you get there
advice_items.summary_en: Define your goal clearly, stay locked in on it, and refuse to quit until you achieve it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 明确目标并保持专注直到达成

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年从事模特行业，退役后转型翻修房屋，再逐步发展为独立住宅开发与建造商，通过持续将利润再投资滚大项目规模。
guests.guest_name: Los Angeles Former Model & Real Estate Developer
guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Home Builder (Former Model)
guests.zero_start_advice: 起步时要敢于冒险并相信自己，把赚到的利润不断再投资并善用1031置换延税以做大规模。

advice_items.quote: don't get down on yourself don't start second guessing yourself and just keep working at it every single day is a new day
advice_items.summary_en: Do not dwell on setbacks or slow sales; treat every day as a fresh chance to keep pushing forward.
advice_items.summary_zh: 面对挫折别自我怀疑，每天坚持向前

advice_items.quote: I can make a decision in a split second and I don't overthink things and don't worry about too many things I just jump right in
advice_items.summary_en: Make decisions quickly without overthinking and jump straight into execution.
advice_items.summary_zh: 果断决策不内耗，直接下场行动

advice_items.quote: early on I always just was like I hustled I figured out how to like get stuff done and I never uh I never took any shortcuts
advice_items.summary_en: Hustle hard early on, figure out how to get things done, and never take shortcuts.
advice_items.summary_zh: 早期拼命实干解决难题，绝不走捷径

advice_items.quote: just work hard invest well save and go for it
advice_items.summary_en: Work hard, save diligently, and invest wisely to reach your major financial goals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 努力工作、积极储蓄并做好投资

guests.first_money_or_break: 从软件工程起步，曾创办科技初创公司并最终被收购，随后转型创办营销代理公司并稳定经营9年。
guests.guest_name: Los Angeles Software Engineer & Marketing Agency Founder
guests.role_or_title: Marketing Agency Founder & Former Software Engineer
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要过度思考、果断决策行动，脚踏实地拼命干且绝不走捷径；同时努力工作、精明投资并坚持储蓄。

advice_items.quote: to bring in good people they have to believe in you you know your dreams got to be so big that everybody's dream can fit inside of it
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by casting a vision large enough that talented people can fulfill their own dreams inside yours.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用足够宏大的愿景吸引优秀人才

advice_items.quote: faith is really taking action before you have what you need... when you put money behind something that's when you know you're committed
advice_items.summary_en: Take action and commit resources before everything is in place to force real commitment.
advice_items.summary_zh: 条件未齐先行动，用真金白银倒逼投入

advice_items.quote: low stress is low performance but when you put yourself in these uncomfortable situations that's when that greatness that lies within comes out
advice_items.summary_en: Intentionally place yourself in high-pressure, uncomfortable situations to unlock peak performance.
advice_items.summary_zh: 主动置身高压不适环境以激发潜能

advice_items.quote: people don't have to believe what you're saying they have to believe that you believe what you're saying cuz everything's a transfer of belief
advice_items.summary_en: Validate your offering until you have total conviction, because selling is a transfer of belief.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售本质是信念传递，先让自己坚信产品

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: I would split my check three ways and I would live on a third of it one would go towards IRS and savings and then the other one would go towards a reserve account
advice_items.summary_en: Divide every paycheck into thirds: live on one-third, set aside one-third for taxes/savings, and lock one-third in an untouched reserve.
advice_items.summary_zh: 收入三等分，只用三分之一生活并留备用金

advice_items.quote: if you don't come from a rich family a rich family can come from you and I made the decision in my family that I was going to be the one person that changed my family tree forever
advice_items.summary_en: Decide that even if you were not born into wealth, you will be the one to transform your family's trajectory.
advice_items.summary_zh: 即便出身贫寒，也要立志改写家族命运

guests.first_money_or_break: 6岁随家人从哥伦比亚移民美国，两周后父母因执法突袭双双入狱，15岁挑起家庭重担打工谋生，21岁创办家庭安防公司并带队挨家挨户地推起步。
guests.zero_start_advice: 条件尚未齐备时就先行动并投入资源逼自己一把，坚持将收入三等分（1/3生活、1/3缴税储蓄、1/3设为绝对不动的备用金），靠自己彻底改写家族命运。
